title: Reception of the MobilityFromNRCommand by the UE

entities.name: MobilityFromNRCommand
entities.description: RRC message that commands the UE to perform inter-RAT mobility from NR to another RAT.

entities.name: Timer T310
entities.description: Timer used in RRC connection management procedures.

entities.name: Timer T312
entities.description: Timer used in RRC connection reconfiguration procedures.

entities.name: Timer T316
entities.description: Timer used in connection re-establishment procedures.

entities.name: Timer T390
entities.description: Timer used for access barring control across different access categories.

entities.name: VarRLF-Report
entities.description: Stored radio link failure report information maintained by the UE.

entities.name: targetRAT-Type
entities.description: IE indicating the target radio access technology for inter-RAT mobility.

entities.name: nas-SecurityParamFromNR
entities.description: IE containing NAS security parameters for inter-RAT mobility from NR.

entities.name: Inter-RAT mobility towards E-UTRA
entities.description: Procedure for mobility from NR to E-UTRA (LTE) network.

entities.name: Inter-RAT mobility towards UTRA-FDD
entities.description: Procedure for mobility from NR to UTRA-FDD (3G) network.

entities.name: Target cell access
entities.description: Procedure for accessing the target cell in the specified RAT.

relations.description: Reception of MobilityFromNRCommand stops timer T310 if running.
Reception of MobilityFromNRCommand stops timer T312 if running.
Reception of MobilityFromNRCommand stops timer T316.
Reception of MobilityFromNRCommand stops timer T390 for all access categories.
Reception of MobilityFromNRCommand clears the information in VarRLF-Report.
MobilityFromNRCommand may contain the nas-SecurityParamFromNR IE.
When targetRAT-Type is set to eutra, inter-RAT mobility towards E-UTRA is initiated.
When targetRAT-Type is set to utra-fdd, inter-RAT mobility towards UTRA-FDD is initiated.
During E-UTRA mobility, nas-SecurityParamFromNR is forwarded to upper layers if included.
During UTRA-FDD mobility, nas-SecurityParamFromNR is forwarded to upper layers if included.
Reception of MobilityFromNRCommand includes accessing the target cell in the target RAT.
